name: vaultpay-backend
description: VaultPay — Microservices Backend (API Gateway, Auth, Wallet, Transaction, Payment)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow" --names "GW,AUTH,WALLET" "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix wallet-service"
scripts.start: npm run infra:up && npm run dev
